questions.question: Please clarify two steps. The sum 1/500+1/1500+1/3500=31/10500 is not itself 3,100 versts: it must be multiplied by the common numerical count N. Thus N·31/10500=3100 and N=3100÷(31/10500)=1050000. The source instead writes 3100÷10500/31=1050000 without the necessary grouping. Please agree a correction; the source operators and correct final distances remain in the draft.

questions.resolution: The derivation now defines the common count N, states N·31/10500=3100 and computes N=3100÷(31/10500)=1,050,000 before deriving the three distances.
